comm-process-pull-request.SKILL.md:
---
name: comm-process-pull-request
description: Use when creating or completing a PR, selecting squash-merge or remote deletion, or enforcing local-branch read-only limits during PR operations.
---

# Process a PR

Inputs: repository, head/base and authorized scope.

Before creation show and await one explicit choice:

1. Обычный PR (pull request)
2. PR (pull request) + squash-merge
3. PR (pull request) + squash-merge + удаление remote ветки

Bind the choice to this PR/scope; reuse it without repeat approval.
Missing/ambiguous answers require clarification and waiting, never a default.
General task approval or green checks alone grants no PR/merge.

Agent/tools must never modify/delete the local branch during any PR operation,
including helpers/cleanup. User manual deletion remains allowed: install no
technical block and never delete as their proxy. Never use gh pr merge --delete-branch.
If local changes are needed, stop for an agreed preparation scope.

Before creating, editing or merging a PR apply harness/common/skills/comm-check-publication-data/SKILL.md
and harness/common/skills/comm-commit-task-stages/references/message-transfer.md.
Before creation read [preparation](references/preparation.md);
merge only for 2/3 after [merge checks](references/merge.md);
delete only for 3 under [remote deletion](references/remote-deletion.md).

Done: report the PR URL and actual selected-stage results/SHAs/gaps.
Protected-harness and production permissions remain separate.
comm-process-pull-request.references/merge.md:
# Merge the checked PR

Recheck repository/PR, head/base names/SHAs, open/non-draft state and mandatory
checks/reviews for the head or tested combined result. Match expected head;
GitHub --match-head-commit guards head, not base. Read
harness/common/skills/comm-verify-project-facts/references/git-base-state.md
for target races and the project's checked-integration mechanism. Never bypass gates.

Queued/requested is not merged. Confirm MERGED, result SHA on intended integration
and actual delta from its real base; inspect unexpected loss/change.
After target advancement require no universal tree equality or patch-id/file-list
proof. Mismatch: stop later actions, report and await the user; no automatic
repair, local mutation or remote cleanup.
comm-process-pull-request.references/remote-deletion.md:
# Delete the agreed remote task ref

Use option 3 after confirmed merge of the agreed PR version.
Recheck head repository/ref, including forks; remote ambiguity needs the user.
Categorically never delete remote main, master, or any primary, integration or
protected branch, including through helpers/mirroring.
New commits, continuing work or dependent open PRs: explain and await the user.
Account for races; prefer an expected-SHA condition at deletion, checking its
availability/limits first.

Obey PR local read-only limits. Affect only the agreed remote ref. Verify remote
absence and preservation of the existing local branch. Discrepancy: stop, report
facts and wait for the user; no autonomous restoration or other changes.
Unavailable checks remain uncertain. Already absent: report, never recreate/redelete.
comm-process-pull-request.references/preparation.md:
# Prepare the PR

Verify repository/head/base and intended commits; ambiguity needs the user.
Before describing PR changes read
harness/common/skills/comm-verify-project-facts/references/git-integration.md.
Separate task changes since the merge base from target advancement.
A head lacking target-only additions is not deleting them in the PR;
judge post-merge effects against the merge-time integration base.
Necessary ordinary publication to the agreed remote is included, not a new fork,
forced rewrite or local branch changes.
Use the project's template: problem/result, actual checks with revision/
environment and evidence links, failed/unrun checks and limits/reasons.
Use comm-run-project-checks for application reports and comm-validate-harness-instructions for harness reports; retain full evidence with comm-protect-harness-evidence.
Update changed scope/version and verify saved text; templates/CLI do not
automatically supply truthful verification content.
